verdict.rationale: Brex's first-party pages say it can automatically block out-of-policy purchases with preset rules and limits, auto-enforce spend controls, and let admins set spending rules. The Budgets/Spend Limits API and Workato integration back up amount-based limits. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of merchant-level and category-level card restrictions, documentation that the decline happens at the point of sale (beyond marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
